verification.graph: The native graph has the complete published 398-tensor namespace, including the two persistent sinusoidal position buffers stored by the released checkpoint.
verification.processor: Native SentencePiece token IDs and all deterministic log-mel values are compared with the reference implementation. Text is EOS-terminated like Transformers >= 4.29 (huggingface/transformers#21824); the pinned v4.28.0 tokenizer does not append EOS.
verification.runtime_dependencies: PyTorch, the Python standard library, and VoiceHub only.
verification.checkpoint_boundary: Released .bin files are accepted only through torch.load(weights_only=True), pinned SHA-256, and complete namespace/shape/dtype/inventory validation. Portable exports use VoiceHub's native Safetensors implementation.
verification.generation: Prenet dropout shares one mask across the batch, and batched generation stops when the summed stop probability of a step reaches the threshold, as in Transformers >= 4.29 (v4.28.0 draws an independent dropout mask for every position and stops when any reduction frame reaches it). The sinusoidal position buffers come from the released checkpoint as in v4.28.0; they differ from the recomputed table that Transformers >= 4.29 uses by up to 1.2e-4.

objective: L1 loss on pre-postnet and postnet spectrograms
binary stop-token loss with positive weight 5
training.raw_data: Native transcript tokenization, resampling, and log-mel target extraction

limitations: The published checkpoint is an English character model.
VoiceHub does not claim corpus-level quality improvements without benchmark evidence.
The official repositories publish restricted-load PyTorch archives, not Safetensors; VoiceHub exports Safetensors after validated conversion.
